title: All Fired Up
start: Talk to King Roald in the Varrock Palace Throne room.

items.t: 45 logs of any kind that you have the Firemaking level to use, in 2 sets of 20 and 1 set of 5. The sets have to be of the same kind for the quest.
Regular logs are enough for the quest, which can be cut from nearby trees.
Some logs like acadia logs, corrupted magic logs, and eternal magic logs will not properly work.
You may refer to All Fired Up (minigame)#Lighting the beacons.

recommended.t: Invitation box for quick transportation, if available.
Alternatively, the Skeletal horror Teleport, Fort Forinthry lodestone, or Fort Forinthry Teleport scrolls may be used.

Bring the items above in the form of the first 20 logs, a hatchet for cutting the other 20 logs from the normal trees between the beacons, and 5 logs of any type to relight the first beacon, along with the required tinderbox.
Equipping any tier of Seer's headband can speed this already short quest up considerably.
Weight-reducing clothing can help since carrying the logs will slow you down. Additionally, any tier of Explorer's ring can help recharge run energy.
You can also use the salt-water spring in Oo'glog or the Anachronia base camp for a temporary and unlimited run energy boost

rewards.t: Access to the All Fired Up minigame

steps.t: Talk to King Roald in Varrock Palace. [Chat: 3 Greet the king. › 1 Oh? Tell me more! › Accept]
p: Blaze Sharpeye (a pyromaniac) guards one of the beacons

steps.t: Talk to Blaze Sharpeye in Silvarea which is north-east of the Varrock Dig Site and south-west of the Paterdomus Temple on the River Salve. [Chat: 1 Does it matter what type of log I use?]
Add-logs to the unlit beacon next to Blaze (requires 20 logs). [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Blaze Sharpeye again. [Chat: 2 Okay.]
Acquire 20 more logs by chopping or banking.
Go north-west to the beacon near the Odd Old Man, add 20 logs and then light it.
Go back and talk to Blaze again. [Chat: 1 Oh, alright, then.]
Add-logs to the beacon (requires 5 logs). [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to King Roald. [Chat: 2 Talk about All Fired Up.]
